name: Oban & Kilchurn
line: ESN day tour, and one we'd recommend: the seaside town under McCaig's Tower, plus Inveraray and Kilchurn Castle on the way.

name: York
line: Medieval walls, Clifford's Tower and the National Railway Museum.

name: Glenfinnan
line: ESN day tour to the Harry Potter viaduct, via Luss on Loch Lomond and Fort William.

name: Falkirk
line: A very therapeutic canal walk from the Falkirk Wheel to the Kelpies.

name: Inchcolm Island
how: Train, then Maid of the Forth ferry
line: An abandoned abbey on an uninhabited island. The boat leaves from Queensferry, a beautiful seaside town under the Forth Bridge.

name: Loch Ness
line: A long ESN day: Glencoe, the Commando Memorial, Fort Augustus and Urquhart Castle.

name: Arbroath
line: Red sandstone cliffs, sea stacks and the coastal walk.

name: Hamilton Park
line: The nearest racecourse to Glasgow.

name: Stirling
line: Castle and Wallace Monument, both up very steep hills. Give yourself more time than you think.

name: Isle of Skye
line: Our best weekend. Eilean Donan, Portree, Sligachan and the Old Man of Storr, the most scenic hike we did.

name: Culross
line: A small town that looks like the Italian countryside.

name: Dunnottar & Stonehaven
line: Clifftop castle ruin a coastal walk from Stonehaven.

name: St Andrews
line: Go on a Sunday, when the Old Course opens to the public. Cheesy Toast Shack and Jannettas are so good.

name: Isle of Arran
line: Absolutely beautiful and close to school. First ferry over, last ferry back. I cannot recommend this island enough.

name: New Lanark
line: A surreal mill village by the Falls of Clyde. Very hilly from the station.

name: Edinburgh
line: The castle, Arthur's Seat, the museum and the Saturday market.

name: Loch Lomond & Hill House
line: Autumn on the loch, then Mackintosh's Hill House.

name: Aberdeen
line: Footdee, the beach, the university and Crathes Castle.

name: East Linton & North Berwick
line: Preston Mill, Tantallon Castle and the beach at North Berwick.

name: Argyll Forest
line: Dunoon, Glenbranter and the Rest and Be Thankful.

name: Dunkeld & Birnam
line: One of my favourite places in Scotland: the Hermitage, a 600-year-old oak and the river.

name: Northern Ireland
line: Belfast, the Giant's Causeway, the Dark Hedges and Derry.

name: Inverness, Aviemore & Wick
line: Culloden, Fort George, Rothiemurchus (outdoor heaven) and the far north coast at Wick.

name: Chester & North Wales
line: Chester, Conwy, Llandudno, Snowdonia and Shrewsbury.
